categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Changhong Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: medical devices and polymer medical consumables, intelligent manufacturing products, and semiconductor consumables. The company provides precision molds, automated production integration, and diversified injection molding solutions across these sectors. It also offers one-stop solutions from product design to manufacturing and assembly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mold design and manufacturing, automated production line integration, and sophisticated injection molding technologies including micro-precision, ultra-precision molding, two-color molding, and thin-wall high-pressure molding. It employs CAD/CAE/CAM/CAPP/PDM/ERP software systems for digital intelligent manufacturing and maintains GMP-compliant cleanrooms for medical consumables production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leaders in medical diagnostics, intelligent manufacturing, and semiconductor industries. The company serves sectors such as gene sequencing, life science laboratories, assisted reproduction, in vitro diagnostics, blood dialysis, smart office equipment, smart home, smart logistics, automotive manufacturing, and semiconductor wafer fabrication. It has established supply chains with 19 globally renowned medical customers and major semiconductor wafer fabs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in Shenzhen, Heyuan, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Vietnam, and the Philippines, with sales primarily in domestic China and international markets including Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific. It has established a marketing center in Switzerland for European operations and is expanding production capacity globally, including plans for facilities in Europe and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changhong Technology operates mainly in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on precision mold manufacturing, injection molding, and automated production integration. It supplies critical components and consumables to downstream manufacturers in medical devices, intelligent manufacturing equipment, and semiconductor wafer processing industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with strong R&D investment in precision molds, automated production integration, and injection molding processes. It focuses on developing high-precision medical consumables, semiconductor wafer carriers, and intelligent manufacturing components. R&D centers include Guangdong Precision Injection Mold Engineering Technology Research Center and Shanghai Emerging Medical Devices and Life Sciences R&D Center. The company aims to enhance core technologies, expand product portfolios, and accelerate internationalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision molds, medical devices and consumables, intelligent manufacturing products, and semiconductor consumables. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, with some distribution channels. It also derives income from investment returns and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise in precision molds and injection molding for medical, intelligent manufacturing, and semiconductor sectors. It competes with multinational corporations in high-end medical devices and semiconductor consumables but emphasizes domestic innovation and localization to capture market share. It has received strategic partnership recognition from global medical giants like Roche Diagnostics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.04 billion, an 11.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 101.96 million, a 222.11% increase. The company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.46 billion with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion. It has a stable growth trajectory supported by continuous R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changhong Technology offers one-stop, customized, high-precision manufacturing solutions integrating advanced mold design, automated production, and injection molding technologies. It emphasizes high product quality, consistency, and compliance with international standards (e.g., GMP, ISO 13485). The company differentiates itself through rapid product development cycles, strong technical support, and a comprehensive after-sales service system, enabling it to meet stringent customer requirements in high-value medical and semiconductor markets.
